description.en: The global switch for API security.

description.zh:
WAF实例ID。

> 您可以通过调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)接口查看当前WAF实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number to return when you perform a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page. For more information about paging, see the API reference.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page when you perform a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates 10 entries per page. For more information about paging, see the API reference.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The name of the protected object.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

title.zh: 查询API安全防护对象生效列表
title.en: Query the list of API security protected objects

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-protection-resources --instance-id waf-cn-0xldbqt0000 --resource cwaf-000-waf --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --apisec-status 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
